## Summary

- Show active automation runs in the Automations sidebar hover, with status icons, details, and grouped run counts.
- Respect shared-automation visibility and Send Later scheduled-chat settings.
- No associated issue (none provided).

## Issues addressed

| Severity | Issue | Resolution |
|---|---|---|
| Enhancement | Active automation status is not visible from the sidebar list. | Added a delayed hover that groups active runs and displays status icons, descriptions, and counts. |

## Review status

- Unresolved actionable findings: None
- Residual risks: The isolated app had no active runs during screenshot capture; active-run grouping and details are covered by focused tests. No other known risks.

Findings.ConfidenceRationale: The new helper resolves each eligible active run before grouping. SessionsManagementService visits registered providers in order; the default Copilot provider rebuilds its cache whenever its size is zero, and that rebuild copies/deduplicates and scans the complete agent-session model. This is statically traced; the prevalence and duration of large histories are not measured.
Findings.PerformanceResource: Full agent-session arrays, migration-deduplication work, and complete provider-cache scans on the UI thread
Findings.PerformanceScaling: For E mouseover/content requests, S total agent-model sessions, and K eligible active-run resources whose lookup reaches the empty Copilot provider, the added work is O(E*K*S), including repeated O(S) array allocations. Grouping into U automation rows happens afterward and does not reduce K; initialized host providers coalesce cold remote listing requests separately.
Findings.PerformanceOutcome: Synchronous UI latency and avoidable CPU/GC pressure while interacting with the sidebar
Findings.PreviousBehavior: The sidebar associated runs with the already-collected automationSessions using a resource map. An empty Copilot cache could be rebuilt during existing session-list refreshes, but not once per active run on entering the Automations row.
Findings.ChangedBehavior: The new hover resolves eligible active runs through the aggregate management service individually. Each lookup that reaches the empty default Copilot provider repeats a full model rebuild, even for a foreign resource. setupDelayedHover resolves this content synchronously on mouseover, before the display delay and hover identity deduplication.
Findings.CausalDiffEvidence: Added line 1039 supplies SessionsManagementService.getSession as the new hover helper's per-run resolver. Added sessionsListRenderers.ts:553 calls it inside the active-run loop, before grouping. Previously the section's automationStatus used one sessionsByResource map, with no per-run provider lookup or mouseover-triggered cache rebuild.
Findings.Title: Avoid per-run rescans of an empty cloud session cache
Findings.Impact: With a large non-cloud session history, no Copilot Cloud sessions, and active runs on a later-registered remote host, entering or moving between children of the Automations row repeatedly copies and scans the entire history for each eligible run. This blocks the UI thread and adds allocation/GC pressure even when the hover is never displayed.
Findings.Evidence: sessionsListRenderers.ts:545-553 loops eligible runs and invokes getSession before grouping. sessionsManagementService.ts:445-446 visits provider.getSession until a match. CopilotChatSessionsProvider.getSession at 1410-1413 calls _ensureSessionCache; 2891-2895 treats size===0 as uninitialized; _refreshSessionCache at 2922-2937 scans model.sessionsIncludingAutomationRuns for Cloud sessions. AgentSessionsModel.ts:562-563 constructs and deduplicates an array of the full model on each read. A user with non-cloud history and no Copilot Cloud sessions therefore never gets a warm negative cache. Copilot is unconditionally registered, and later-connected remote providers can be visited after it. HoverService.ts:230-233 evaluates the callback on each bubbling mouseover before showDelayedHover.
Findings.Recommendation: Ensure an authoritative empty Copilot session cache is considered initialized, refreshing it through the existing model.onDidChangeSessions path rather than on every lookup, before introducing these per-run hover lookups.

Scenarios.Scenario: Mouse interaction with the Automations sidebar entry, including visible shared automations and Send Later exclusions
Scenarios.CriticalPath: On each bubbling mouseover, HoverService synchronously resolves the new content factory before hover identity deduplication and before the display timer. Filtering, eligible-run session lookups, plaintext conversion, and initial hover construction must finish before the event returns. Cold host listing requests are not awaited.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Synchronously parse and sanitize live Markdown descriptions into plaintext, then render the grouped hover Markdown into DOM
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Up to one plaintext parse per eligible run with an active resolved session and description; each input is capped at 100,000 characters by renderAsPlaintext. One grouped hover render per newly accepted hover, with U automation rows. Content computation occurs even when hover identity subsequently deduplicates the request.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The Automations entry had no corresponding summary or Markdown hover construction; existing section-status processing remains unchanged.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Runs synchronously in mouseover handling before delayed presentation; no network or media fetch is added by the escaped names/details and fixed span markup.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Initialize a cold connected host's session cache through its existing host connection
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: At most one initial request per connected, uninitialized provider reached by lookups; zero after successful initialization, including empty success, and zero additional requests while a listing or retry is pending.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The new hover lookup path did not exist. The same initialization already occurred through normal sidebar getSessions/getAllSessions calls, so typically no additional request is issued.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Started without awaiting from getSession; the hover uses available cached data or fallback run status. Listing completion is off the hover's critical path.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: D automation descriptors and H recorded runs are scanned; K eligible active runs with resources are resolved before grouping into U automation rows. Shared-by-others and scheduled-chat filters reduce K before lookup. In the reported case, Kc of these lookups reach an empty default Copilot provider with S total agent-model sessions, adding O(Kc*S) per content request. Cloud history is limited to 50 recent runs per fetched definition; agent-host history also includes retained records.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Content generation and cache scans are serial on the UI thread. A cold connected host can initiate one listing per provider, shared while in flight and suppressed during retry backoff; this does not become one remote call per run. No hover-triggered cloud history refresh occurs.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Automation snapshots are existing derived observables already consumed by the section status. Host resource caches and Copilot session wrappers reuse successful lookups. Host cold initialization is guarded by in-flight refresh/backoff and treats empty success as initialized. The default Copilot provider instead uses nonzero cache size as initialization: with no Cloud sessions, each lookup that reaches it recopies/deduplicates and scans the full model. Hover content itself is recomputed before hover-service deduplication.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: callback timing, filtering before lookup, grouping after lookup, provider traversal, positive/negative cache behavior, full-model allocation/scanning, and cold-request coalescing were inspected directly.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: No timings or production history sizes are available. Negative-cache amplification requires an empty Copilot Cloud cache and lookup reachability, for example later-connected remote providers; exact duration depends on total model history and active runs. This affects severity, not the established multiplicative mechanism.
Scenarios.Verdict: One medium-severity cache-lifecycle regression submitted: new per-run mouseover lookups materially amplify the existing empty-Copilot-cache rebuild. Ordinary grouped rendering and bounded cold host requests do not independently justify additional findings.

Scenarios.Scenario: Keyboard hover command while the Automations row is focused in either navigation placement
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The command event listener first filters the command ID and focused list root, searches currently rendered section templates, then synchronously builds and displays the same summary. Unrelated commands do not compute summaries. Nested controls and unfocused lists are rejected.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Build, sanitize, and render the automation summary for the focused hover command
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One summary computation per accepted command; up to K live-description conversions and one U-row hover render.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The focused list root had no automation-specific hover command behavior.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Synchronous work must finish before the keyboard hover can receive focus.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Potential existing cold-host session listing reached through the new resolver
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Zero warm calls; at most one in-flight initialization per connected uninitialized provider reached, not per active run.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: No automation-specific keyboard lookup existed; normal list initialization already initialized these caches.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Not awaited; unavailable sessions use run fallback details.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: One active SessionsList target per valid focused-root invocation; rendered-section search is bounded by currently rendered templates, not all history rows. Summary multiplicity is D/H/K/U as in the mouse scenario.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: One synchronous command-handler computation; no per-run asynchronous jobs or extra cloud refresh. Cold host listings retain the existing per-provider joining/backoff behavior.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Uses the same existing automation snapshots and session caches; the empty Copilot cache has the same reported amplification. MutableDisposable replaces the previous keyboard hover, and list disposal releases the command listener and hover.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: focused-root guards, bounded rendered-template lookup, summary call path, command-service hover ancestor search, and disposal ownership were inspected.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Keyboard invocation is user-driven rather than a high-frequency event. No measured command latency is available.
Scenarios.Verdict: Shares the submitted negative-cache root cause; no separate concurrency, repeated hover creation, or unbounded-retention finding.

Scenarios.Scenario: Sidebar initialization, section recycling, and live automation/session updates without opening a hover
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Renderer creation stores a callback; rendering an Automations section registers hover listeners but does not execute the summary callback. Existing reactive automation-status computation still drives the icon. Normal provider discovery and cached session listing remain on their original paths.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Maintain the provider-owned automation catalogue subscription
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One existing reference per store/connection, not per rendered template or hover.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same catalogue subscription and reactive section-status reads already existed.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Supplies existing live icon/catalogue data; summary reads do not acquire another subscription.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Existing account-driven/background cloud discovery and history refresh, including automations.listRuns and tasks.get
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One listRuns request per included cached cloud definition, returning at most 50 runs; additional tasks.get only for active task states. Four definition queues run concurrently; task detail requests are serial within each queue.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Identical provider-owned initial refresh, visibility refresh, and history request scheduling before this PR.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Background state population remains independent of hover completion; reading automations/runs does not initiate another refresh.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Currently rendered Automations templates, including potential sticky copies, and existing provider/automation/session collections. Element disposal clears registered hover listeners and renderedSections entries. One command listener and one bounded keyboard-hover slot per SessionsList lifetime.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: No new summary computation during render or live status updates. Existing host catalogue subscriptions are provider-owned. Cloud refresh operations are sequenced per store; history work has a four-definition limiter with active task details fetched serially within each definition.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Existing section automationStatus maps the already-collected automationSessions once per reactive evaluation. Host and cloud catalogues are projected from existing subscriptions/caches. Storage visibility reads use the in-memory storage cache, not a synchronous database read. Hover registration does not invalidate caches.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: callback-only construction, renderer disposal, storage cache access, provider aggregate reads, cloud initialization/history implementation, and host catalogue ownership were inspected.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Provider counts and existing refresh durations are not measured, but their request cardinality and placement are unchanged.
Scenarios.Verdict: No additional startup, network fan-out, eager hidden summary construction, or lifetime leak introduced. The old cache rebuild is reported only where the new hover loop materially multiplies it, not as an unrelated provider optimization.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance-review pass across the complete five-file inventory and every diff page. Traced pointer and keyboard summaries, visibility filtering, session-provider resolution, negative caches, Markdown conversion, cold host IPC, pre-existing cloud history requests, and renderer/list cleanup. Submitted one medium-severity, high-confidence negative-cache amplification finding. No concrete regression fix introduced by this PR was identified. Static review only; timing and prevalence remain unmeasured.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
